subject: kite-eared ink cub
requested_medium: ink silhouette with flat fluorescent accents
art_direction: 幼兽身体像不规则墨团，展开的风筝耳有明亮色块，尾巴绕成细弧。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Draw a small cub made from one irregular dark ink silhouette, with a rounded belly and large kite-shaped ears. One ear opens fully to show a flat pink panel; the other folds forward with a sharp chartreuse underside. A thin curved tail loops beside the body without enclosing it. The cub crouches with alert curiosity, its small face defined by reserved paper shapes and a tiny sideways mouth. Use warm ivory paper and minimal brush texture. Keep the color accents broad, avoiding fur detail, gradients, or a repeated emoji expression. Square 1024x1024. Keep the complete central silhouette within a circular crop, occupying about 70% of the canvas. Original design; no lettering, logos, or watermark.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
